rule.text: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

agent.problem: This false statement is the walkthrough's only coverage of verse 13. No later card supplies that detail.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

human.problem: The card cites "Joshua 11:1, 10" because it reminds the baker that Hazor is Jabin's city (v1) while telling v10. The docs say to cite "from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower" and to write ranges with a hyphen. Here that would be Joshua 11:1-10, which is wider than what the card uses. A comma list isn't described in the docs. Elsewhere, stop 1 card 1 handles outside context with an inline reference instead, "(Joshua 10)".
human.question: When a story card reminds the baker of a fact from an earlier verse that was already told, how should it be cited? Options: a comma list like "Joshua 11:1, 10", the full range "Joshua 11:1-10", or only the new verse ("Joshua 11:10").
